items.workflow: Handoff obtains authorized funds and pays for the accepted work. Evaluating, originating and administering an optional retrofit financing product is a separate service.
items.reason: The inspected package changes finance-entity enrollment, eligible financial products, collateral, project enrollment and lender loss reserves. Its ability to fund repairs does not establish a requirement governing those repairs or the departing account. Existing property commitments remain facts to honor; this decision does not erase them.
items.register_change: Exclude the optional GoGreen financing-program selections and their edition chase; reconcile the broad Title4 Division13 selector so it does not silently reselect those programs. Preserve the recovered sources and known legal-status facts.

items.decision: remove settlement-amendment chase; retain narrow permit dependencies
items.workflow: Obtain a legally valid approval where required for readiness work. Political Reform Act violation settlement is not itself that approval process.
items.reason: Section18438.2 excludes purely ministerial decisions. Sections18360.1–.3 provide voluntary political-enforcement resolution and penalties. Their reference to84308 does not establish that selecting a settlement tier changes a repair approval. Underlying covered-proceeding disclosure, disqualification and cure requirements remain relevant where they actually govern the approval.
items.register_change: Remove the independently selected streamlined-settlement sections and August amendments from required compilation; reconcile their mixed enforcement-unit references. Preserve the substantive permit dependency and its actual applicability limits. Do not infer the unresolved amendments' legal status.

items.workflow: Specify and price required roof/exterior repairs needed for next-occupant readiness.
items.reason: The inspected text expressly addresses repair and replacement on existing structures. This changes work specifications within the agreed job, without expanding Handoff into new development.
items.remaining_j1: Determine which Part7 provisions govern older-building alterations and exposed open-eave underside materials on the relevant dates. The emergency text removes the pre-July2008 remodel exception and ordinary two-inch lumber underside option; readoption changes no substance. Use sufficient authoritative edition/status evidence, not a required administrative form.

items.workflow: Resolve assistance payments, deposits, inspections and tenancy-exit requirements for participating tenancies.
items.reason: The agreements expressly incorporate operating guidelines. Choosing the wrong edition could change account or readiness requirements. These are direct tenancy-program dependencies, unlike choosing a new capital-financing product.
items.remaining_j1: Identify the operative local TBRA guidelines and mandatory landlord/tenant forms affecting refund recipient, subsidy credits, termination notices and inspection corrections. Authoritative common-edition evidence can suffice; do not require both physical ExhibitA copies or compile unrelated provider administration.

items.workflow: Determine applicable exposure-warning treatment when a cleaning or repair method used for the turnover causes a covered exposure.
items.reason: The inspected amendment concerns safe-harbor levels, with identified solvent-cleaner and adhesive uses. A safe harbor can avoid unnecessary warnings or unsupported exposure conclusions within that work. This is not a mandate to study all chemical manufacturing or derive new toxicology. Chemical presence alone does not establish exposure or duty.
items.remaining_j1: Use the supplied official section25705 text, current through September18,2026, as the established baseline. Resolve only whether a later or future-effective action changes the two relevant safe-harbor entries used for actual covered cleaning/repair exposure decisions; do not infer outcome from absence or require a particular filing document.

items.workflow: Determine the budget and completion requirements for a necessary repair that creates a regulated discharge.
items.reason: The cited excavation category concerns sediment/soil removal in shallow waters or under no-flow conditions. Utility trenching and drainage maintenance are examples inside that category, not a basis to apply these fees to every repair trench. Unrelated fee categories in the same package do not become Handoff work.
items.remaining_j1: Establish authoritative applicable section2200 fee text and timing for covered fill/excavation, construction and dewatering work. Compare current text with the adopted amendment only where charges or continuing obligations differ; a sufficient official schedule/history can settle this without reconstructing each filing.
